summary: United Maritime Corp filed a Form 6-K reporting Q2 and first-half 2026 financial results, a strategic fleet repositioning into Capesize vessels, and a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share. The filing includes asset sales (Panamax and Kamsarmax vessels) and an exit from an offshore vessel investment, but these are operational capital redeployment activities, not a special-situation event. The dividend is routine. No acquisition, divestiture of a business, spin-off, restructuring, or other special category applies. The filing is a standard earnings report for a foreign private issuer.
